body: Hey, I know your inbox is flooded by agencies promising to grow {COMPANY}. / But we recently took Purdy & Figg from GBP 452k to GBP 50m in 4 years, primarily via a mix of creator, UGC and customer-generated content at scale that turned them into a household brand. / Figured I'd drop a note because we're crushing it in the UK scene rn (also working with Protein Works + Saltyface). / Don't know if it's relevant at the moment, but can I walk you through what we did for them? / Thanks, Cody Wittick | Founder & CEO, Kynship / P.S. offer: UGC / creator-content for Meta ads (creator seeding)

cta: can I walk you through what we did for them?
why_it_worked: Beat a near-identical variant (EL1) on the same list/window; the only meaningful difference was the mechanism framing. This one uses a HIGHER-LEVEL, abstract mechanism ('a mix of creator, UGC & customer-generated content at scale') that the buyer can project their own win onto, plus an aspirational outcome ('turned them into a household brand') the specific variant lacked. Notably it's also the BRAGGIER variant ('took ... to GBP 50m', 'crushing it') yet still won - cutting against the SMS lesson sophistication-up-bragging-down; recorded honestly. Provisional: on cold email an abstract mechanism > a granular/throughput one (opposite of SMS). Low-n (~505/arm) - confirm on a re-run.
